english.title: Use the ounce troy / metric carat / pint / prohibited millilitre measure for trade
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used for trade

(A)_[the ounce troy other than for the purpose of transactions in, or in articles made from, gold, silver or other precious metals,]_
(B)_[the carat (metric) other than for the purpose of transactions in precious stones or pearls,]_
(C)_[a capacity measure of **(..SPECIFY 35 / 70 / 125 / 150 or 175..) millilitres other than for the purpose of transactions in intoxicating liquor,]_
(D)_[the pint other than for the purpose of the sale of draught beer or cider or milk in returnable containers,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY THE PROHIBITED TRANSACTION OR PURPOSE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 8(2) and (4) and 84(1) and (2) of the Weights and Measures Act 1985.

english.notes:
(i) Section 8(4) of the Weights and Measures Act 1985 provides that any measure or weight used, or in any person's possession for use shall be liable to be forfeited.
(ii) Section 83(1) of the Weights and Measures Act 1985 provides that in England and Wales, proceedings for any offence under this Act or any instrument made under this Act. shall not be instituted except by or on behalf of a local weights and measures authority or the chief officer of police for a police area.
